# Amazon Bedrock Overview — captured 2026-07-06

## What's New (newest at top)
- **OpenAI GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 now available in Amazon Bedrock** (cached): frontier models for complex work, agentic coding, reasoning, long-running tasks; via Responses API.
- **Claude Opus 4.7 now available** (cached).
- **Claude Mythos Preview (Gated Research Preview)** (cached): state-of-the-art cybersecurity/coding/reasoning; gated preview US East (N. Virginia).
- **Cost allocation by IAM user and role** (cached): CUR 2.0 + Cost Explorer attribution across users/teams/projects.
